title: File:Arrow-3 Feb-25-2013 (1).jpg
author: United States Missile Defense Agency
description: Feb. 25, 2013 - The Israel Missile Defense Organization (IMDO) and the U.S. Missile Defense Agency (MDA) completed a successful flight test of the Arrow-3 interceptor missile. The Arrow-3 interceptor successfully launched and flew an exo-atmospheric trajectory through space, according to the test plan.
